name: Base Game Modern House 1
author: SimsWithNora
style: Two-storey modern: a dark-timber flat-roofed box under a floating two-band lid, carried on white and striped piers, stands forward of a white, steep street gable with a projecting open rake; a stair slot window, a glazed entry pair, a two-pane bay; gravel forecourt, deck with a rill and ball shrubs, a basin by the drive
